title: Learning from Past Mistakes: AI-Assisted Analytics of Software Defects and Their Fixes for Future Defect Prevention - An Industrial Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.26889v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context. Despite advances in software testing and quality assurance, defects continue to recur in industrial software systems. Defect data are routinely collected in issue-tracking systems, but their use is largely confined to detection, reporting, and short-term resolution, leaving the knowledge embedded in historical defects and their fixes under-exploited for prevention and long-term improvement. Objective. This paper investigates how historical defect and defect-fix data can be analyzed, with AI assistance under human oversight, to identify the human-error origins of recurring defects and to feed that understanding back into prevention and QA improvement. Method. We developed an AI-assisted, human-in-the-loop analytics approach that classifies defects by failure type and by human-error origin across the SDLC, determines how each could have been prevented, and synthesizes engineer-focused capability-building insights. It was deployed

translated_title: 从过去的错误中学习：AI辅助的软件缺陷及其修复分析助力未来缺陷预防——一项工业案例研究
translated_abstract: 背景：尽管软件测试和质量保证技术不断进步，缺陷在工业软件系统中仍持续反复出现。缺陷数据通常会被收集在问题跟踪系统中，但其用途大多局限于检测、报告和短期解决，历史缺陷及其修复中所蕴含的知识在缺陷预防和长期改进方面的价值尚未得到充分利用。目标：本文研究如何在人工监督下借助AI辅助，对历史缺陷及缺陷修复数据进行分析，以识别重复出现缺陷的人为错误根源，并将这种理解反馈到缺陷预防和质量保证改进之中。方法：我们开发了一种AI辅助、人在回路的分析方法，该方法按照故障类型和软件开发生命周期（SDLC）中的人为错误根源对缺陷进行分类，确定每个缺陷本可以如何被预防，并总结出面向工程师的能力建设洞察。该方法已被部署应用于……
tldr: 该论文提出一种AI辅助、人在回路的缺陷分析方法，通过分析历史缺陷及其修复数据识别重复缺陷的人为错误根源，并将其转化为预防措施和面向工程师的能力建设洞察，从而实现未来的缺陷预防与质量保证改进。
